2609.15037.title: MoARa: Module-Aware Rank Allocation and Structure-Preserving Decomposition for Low-Rank LLM Pre-training
2609.15037.paper_summary: Low-rank gradient projection reduces the optimizer-state memory cost of large language model (LLM) pretraining, but the steps and wall-clock time needed to reach a target quality remain a meaningful axis for improvement. We attribute this to two design choices in existing methods: the projection-rank budget is allocated uniformly across Transformer modules with heterogeneous projection sensitivity, and projecting a raw gradient attenuates its magnitude and direction jointly. We propose MoARa, which combines a static profiling-based module-aware projection-rank allocation with a block-wise magnitude-direction decomposition; the default block size is set in the neighborhood of the attention head dimension. Across five Transformer architectures spanning Llama, Qwen, and DeepSeek at 300M to 7B scales, GaLore with MoARa reaches standard GaLore's final perplexity in 37% fewer steps and 34% less wall-clock time on Llama 2 7B, with only 0.2% peak reserved memory overhead under standard graph compilation. Across the six low-rank pretraining methods we evaluate, module-aware rank allocation alone delivers directionally consistent step reductions on all six. On compatible hosts, the two-component design reaches up to 41.7% step reduction and 37.1% wall-clock reduction.
2609.15037.paper_summary_zh: 低秩梯度投影降低了大型語言模型（LLM）預訓練的優化器狀態記憶成本，但達到目標質量所需的步驟和實際時間仍然是一個有意義的改進方向。我們將此歸因於現有方法中的兩個設計選擇：投影秩預算在具有異質投影敏感度的Transformer模組之間均勻分配，並且對原始梯度的投影共同減弱了其大小和方向。我們提出了MoARa，該方法結合了基於靜態剖析的模組感知投影秩分配和塊狀大小-方向分解；默認塊大小設置在注意力頭維度的附近。在涵蓋Llama、Qwen和DeepSeek的五種Transformer架構中，GaLore與MoARa在Llama 2 7B上以37%的步驟減少和34%的實際時間減少達到了標準GaLore的最終困惑度，且在標準圖編譯下僅有0.2%的峰值保留記憶開銷。在我們評估的六種低秩預訓練方法中，僅模組感知秩分配就能在所有六種方法上實現方向性一致的步驟減少。在兼容的主機上，這種雙組件設計實現了高達41.7%的步驟減少和37.1%的實際時間減少。
2609.15037.author: Keunyoung Kim et.al.
